Cheap AI

1.) Abusive stun spam that leads to endless juggles
2.) Your own stun attacks barely register and when they do it's less than 2 seconds of hinderance
3.) Near flawless aim on the synthetic enemies
4.) Tanks with more health proportionate to "supposed" difficulty and enemy type than Borderlands raid bosses and anyone who has played those games knows those enemies are a more health meme

All of this is on the "standard" difficulty something Focus and their child studios routinely prove to be inept at understanding. If you want souls hard just say it don't continually lie about not trying to pander to that crowd

And if you have an AI companion? Of course they have to be worthless can't give solo players any equalizers after all to our cheap as heck AI.

The game is pretty okay. Feels really stiff and janky. It does some interesting mechanics such as challenge cards and weapon RNG stats (I think). In the end, didn't really click with me but i can imagine there are people who would enjoy this game.

Closest comparison i can make is The Division style level/class system with World War Z gameplay. Honestly speaking, go for either of those 2 games unless you're fine with a lesser variant or you're a big fan of Aliens theme/lore.

Aliens: Fireteam Elite is a decent game that offers a unique gameplay experience. The gameplay is satisfying and strategic, with a wide range of weapons and enemies to take on. The graphics are good and the overall atmosphere of the game is immersive and atmospheric.  The replay value is high due to the ability to play through the game with different playstyles and the inclusion of a multiplayer mode. The multiplayer aspect is a major highlight, as it adds an extra layer of depth to the game and allows you to connect with other players. Overall, while there are a few minor flaws, Aliens: Fireteam Elite is a good game that I recommend to fans of the genre or anyone looking for a unique and challenging gaming experience.

Aliens Fireteam Elite is out of this world! No, really, it's straight out of the Aliens Universe! And let me tell you, it's amazing! I've been having an absolute blast playing with up to three friends, fighting off hordes of xenomorphs and immersing myself in the lore of the the hive, the marines, the engineers, and of course, the pathogen.

I've finished both the main campaign and the Pathogen DLC, and let me tell you, it's worth it. This game will immerse you so deeply into the Alien story that you'll start to question whether you're a human or a xenomorph. Just make sure you don't accidentally chest-burst out of excitement!

I mean, who wouldn't want to spend their days blasting away at aliens and dodging acid blood? It's like a dream come true, if your dream is to be in constant danger of becoming a facehugger's next meal. But hey, that's just the risk you have to take when you want to have a good time.

In short, Aliens Fireteam Elite is fantastic! It's the perfect game for those who want to experience the thrill of battling aliens without actually having to leave the safety of their own home. So grab your pulse rifle, grab some friends, and get ready for an unforgettable ride through the dark, terrifying world of the Alien franchise. Just make sure you don't get too scared and accidentally shoot your friend in the back. Or do, it's all part of the fun!
